now.heroTitle: Show what you want right now
now.heroBody: This is a live signal for the near future: short, location-based, and clearly not an announcement.
now.myStatusBody: A short signal for the next moment, not a structured request.
now.roomsCardBody: Rooms shows what is happening nearby, while Together carries the one-on-one path.
now.promptTitle: What do you want right now?
now.placeholder: For example: up for a 20-minute walk / want coffee right now…
now.noneNearby: Nobody nearby has posted a right-now signal yet. This space only shows what people want right now, while Announcements keeps clearer plans.
nearby.now.locationLoadingBody: Checking location. Until it is ready, Now cannot honestly show people nearby or let you post a right-now signal.
nearby.now.locationBlockedTitle: Now cannot open honestly without location
nearby.now.locationBlockedBody: Now depends on who is around you at this moment. While location access is off, there is no nearby signal and no way to post your own.
nearby.now.locationDeclinedTitle: Turn on location to open Now
nearby.now.locationDeclinedBody: Without location, this section cannot show people nearby or post your right-now signal. As soon as you enable it, the feed and posting become available.
nearby.now.locationRetryBody: Location is already allowed, but the coordinates have not refreshed yet. Until then, the feed and right-now posting stay unavailable.
nearby.now.locationPromptTitle: Turn on location for nearby people
nearby.now.locationPromptBody: This section is about what is happening around your place right now. Without location, it cannot honestly show people nearby or accept your signal.
nearby.heroTitle: Right now, clear asks, and live rooms nearby
nearby.heroBody: Now is for right-now signals. Announcements is for clearer asks. Rooms opens the live group space nearby.
nearby.segment.nowBody: A momentary signal nearby: short status and what you want in the next moment.
nearby.segment.announcementsBody: A structured request: who you are looking for, where it matters, and what kind of plan you want.
nearby.segment.roomsBody: Entry into the live group space nearby: map, place, and shared chat.
nearby.announcements.title: Announcements nearby
nearby.announcements.body: This is not a right-now status. It keeps more structured requests: who you are looking for, where, and what kind of meeting you want.
nearby.announcements.emptyBody: Announcements are for clearer asks: who you want to meet, where, and what kind of plan you have in mind. You can post the first one and define this section.
nearby.announcements.emptyFilteredBody: Try another filter or post the first announcement in this format.

nearby.detail.photoWithBody: The image helps explain the format of the request and the context of meeting up.
nearby.detail.photoWithoutBody: This is a text-first announcement. Everything important is already in the description below.

nearby.create.title: Create announcement
nearby.create.heroBody: This is a structured ask, not the right-now status from Now. Keep it short and clear: who you are looking for, where, and what kind of plan you want.
nearby.create.photoBody: Optional. You can still publish the announcement without an image.
nearby.create.photoAttachedHint: Your photo is attached. You can already see how the card will look in the announcements list below.
nearby.create.titlePlaceholder: For example: Looking for company for an evening walk
nearby.create.descriptionPlaceholder: Who are you looking for, what format do you want, and why is this request relevant right now?
nearby.create.cityPlaceholder: For example: Center, Warsaw, or Mokotow
nearby.create.previewBodyFallback: This is where people will see who you are looking for, where it applies, and why it is worth responding.
nearby.create.previewFooter: After publishing, it will appear in Announcements nearby and open like a regular card.

nearby.create.fillBody: Add a title and a short description so it is clear who you are looking for and why.
nearby.create.publishHint: Fill in the title and description. The preview below shows how people nearby will see the announcement.
nearby.create.publishReadyHint: After publishing, you will return to Announcements nearby, where the card appears in the list right away.
rooms.title: Rooms

legal.privacy.title: Privacy Policy
legal.privacy.body:
# Privacy Policy — Amoria
Last updated: 2025-08-15

We collect minimal data to provide core features:
- Profile (name, birthdate, gender, interests, goal, mood)
- Location while the app is in use for "people nearby"
- User content (texts, reports, blocks)

No ads, no data selling. You can delete your account in the app.
Contact: support@amoria.app

inbox.offlineBodyCoreLoop: We couldn't connect your personal chats right now. Try again later or go back to Together.
dm.notFoundFromConnectionBody: The connection may already be open, but the personal chat has not attached yet. Go back to Connections or try again in a moment.
dm.notFoundFromStoryBody: The connection may already have opened after this shared story, but the personal chat has not attached yet. Try again in a moment or go back to the story.
dm.notFoundFromInboxBody: This personal chat has not appeared in the list yet. Go back to Conversations or try opening it again a little later.
dm.emptyBodyWithSourceCoreLoop: You are not starting from zero: the shared moment is already saved, and you can make the first personal step below.
dm.emptyBodyCoreLoop: The conversation is already open. You can write first below and set the tone from here.
play.activityStory.draw: One shared drawing on a single canvas.
play.activityStory.chainDraw: One drawing built together in short turns.
play.activityStory.dailyPrompt: One shared drawing around the prompt of the day.
play.activityStory.colorMood: A shared palette and the soft visual result of this session.
play.modeContext.chainDraw.title: Turn-based drawing
play.modeContext.chainDraw.body.result: This result was built in short turns on one shared canvas.
play.modeContext.chainDraw.body.detail: This is where your turn-based drawing stays: one canvas, short turns, and a clear handoff rhythm.
play.modeContext.chainDraw.body.history: One shared drawing you built together in short turns.
play.modeContext.dailyPrompt.title: Shared prompt of the day
play.modeContext.dailyPrompt.body.result: This result grew out of one shared prompt and one shared canvas.
play.modeContext.dailyPrompt.body.detail: This is where the drawing from your shared prompt stays: one prompt, one canvas, one result.
play.modeContext.dailyPrompt.body.histor: One shared drawing the two of you made around the prompt of the day.
play.modeContext.colorMood.title: Your shared palette
play.modeContext.colorMood.body.result: You each chose colors first, and the shared palette came together here.
play.modeContext.colorMood.body.detail: This page keeps the shared palette and both color choices from this session.
play.modeContext.colorMood.body.history: This is where the shared colors and the result of this palette stay.
play.modeContext.colorMood.emptyBody.his: This story was saved without the full shared palette, but the result still stayed in your history.
play.modeContext.colorMood.emptyBody.def: This session ended before the full shared palette came together. The colors that were saved still remain in the story.
play.modeContext.draw.title: Free shared drawing
play.modeContext.draw.body.result: This is one free shared drawing for two people: one canvas and one result.
play.modeContext.draw.body.detail: This is where your free shared drawing stays: one canvas and one shared rhythm.
play.modeContext.draw.body.history: One shared canvas, a free rhythm, and the drawing that stayed in your story.
play.resultMode.chainDraw.heroBody.histo: This is where the finished turn-based drawing stays.
play.resultMode.chainDraw.heroBody.resul: The result of the turn-based drawing that just finished.
play.resultMode.chainDraw.route.history: This page keeps the shared context, the replay, and the way back into personal chat.
play.resultMode.chainDraw.route.result: From here, the shared result either moves into a personal connection or stays as a saved story.
play.resultMode.dailyPrompt.heroBody.his: This is where the finished drawing from your shared prompt stays.
play.resultMode.dailyPrompt.heroBody.res: The result of the drawing around your shared prompt that just finished.
play.resultMode.dailyPrompt.route.histor: This page keeps the shared context, the replay, and the way back into personal chat.
play.resultMode.dailyPrompt.route.result: From here, the shared result either moves into a personal connection or stays as a saved story.
play.resultMode.colorMood.heroBody.histo: This is where the finished shared palette stays.
play.resultMode.colorMood.heroBody.resul: The result of the mood palette that just finished.
play.resultMode.colorMood.route.history: This page keeps the shared context, the palette, and the way back into personal chat.
play.resultMode.colorMood.route.result: From here, the shared result either moves into a personal connection or stays as a saved story.
play.resultMode.draw.heroBody.history: This is where the finished shared drawing stays.
play.resultMode.draw.heroBody.result: The result of the shared session that just finished.
play.resultMode.draw.route.history: This page keeps the shared context, the replay, and the way back into personal chat.
play.resultMode.draw.route.result: From here, the shared result either moves into a personal connection or stays as a saved story.
play.replay.chainDraw.title: Replay of the turn-based drawing
play.replay.chainDraw.body: The turns run in their original order so you can quickly return to the rhythm of this session.
play.replay.chainDraw.emptyBody: This session was saved without strokes. The result and connection status stayed, but the replay of the turn-based drawing is unavailable here.
play.replay.dailyPrompt.title: Replay of the shared prompt drawing
play.replay.dailyPrompt.body: The strokes run in their original order so you can quickly return to this drawing.
play.replay.dailyPrompt.emptyBody: This session was saved without strokes. The result and the prompt stayed, but the replay of the drawing is unavailable here.
play.replay.draw.title: Replay of the shared drawing
play.replay.draw.body: The strokes run in their original order so you can quickly return to this shared moment.
play.replay.draw.emptyBody: This session was saved without strokes. The result and connection status stayed, but the replay is unavailable here.
play.reveal.openOpen.description: After this shared result, both of you opened the connection and moved it into personal chat.
play.reveal.openSkip.description: One person was ready to open the connection, but this moment still remained only a shared story.
play.reveal.skipSkip.description: Both of you chose to keep this moment as a shared story and not move it into personal chat.
play.reveal.waiting.description: One answer is already saved. We are waiting for the second one to see whether the personal chat opens.
play.result.bridgeHistoryChatReadyTitle: This story already became a connection
play.result.bridgeChatReadyTitle: The shared result already became a connection
play.result.bridgeHistoryChatReadyBody: The connection already lives in Connections, and this story remains its shared context.
play.result.bridgeChatReadyBody: The shared result already opened a connection between you. It now lives in Connections, and you can go straight into the personal chat.
play.result.bridgeChatReadyNextBody: You can open the personal chat right away or open the connection first and return to its shared story from there.
play.result.bridgeChatReadyHint: When you leave this screen, the connection stays in Connections and the shared story stays saved.
play.result.bridgeHistoryChatPendingBody: The connection is already saved, but the personal chat has not attached to this story yet.
play.result.bridgeChatPendingBody: Both of you already chose to open, but the personal chat has not attached yet.
play.result.bridgeChatPendingNextTitle: Open the shared story for now
play.result.bridgeChatPendingNextBody: You can open the saved story now or return to Connections a little later. The connection is already there.
play.result.bridgeChatPendingHint: Nothing is lost here. The story is saved, the connection is open, and the personal chat should appear after sync.
play.result.bridgeHistoryStoryStateTitle: The shared result is already saved
play.result.bridgeHistoryWaitingBody: This story is already saved, and the second answer has not arrived yet.
play.result.bridgeHistoryStoryStateBody: This shared moment is already saved as a story you can return to anytime.
play.result.bridgeHistoryStoryNextBody: Open the full story if you want the replay, the full context, and a calmer way back to this result.
play.result.bridgeHistoryStoryHint: The story is already saved, whether or not the personal chat opened.
play.result.bridgeWaitingBody: You already made your choice after the shared result, and now we are waiting for the second answer.
play.result.bridgeWaitingNextBody: If the second person also chooses to open, the personal chat will appear here. If not, the moment stays a shared story.
play.result.bridgeWaitingHint: You can leave this screen. The shared result is already saved, and the second answer can catch up later.
play.result.bridgeHistoryStoryOnlyTitle: This story stayed between the two of you
play.result.bridgeStoryOnlyTitle: This moment stayed a shared story
play.result.bridgeOpenSkipBody: One person was ready to open the connection, but this moment still remained only a shared story.
play.result.bridgeSkipSkipBody: Both of you chose to keep this moment as a shared story and not move it into personal chat.
play.result.bridgeStoryOnlyNextTitle: Return to the story or start again
play.result.bridgeStoryOnlyNextBody: Open the saved story, watch the replay, or start another shared session if you want to give this connection another chance.
play.result.bridgeStoryOnlyHint: Even without personal chat, this shared result does not disappear: the {story} stays saved.
play.result.bridgeDecisionTitle: First, there was a shared result
play.result.bridgeDecisionBody: Now you can decide whether this moment stays a shared story or becomes a step toward personal connection.
play.result.bridgeDecisionNextTitle: Choose whether you want to open the connection
play.result.bridgeDecisionPaletteNextBod: If both of you choose to open, the palette leads into personal chat. If not, it stays your shared story.
play.result.bridgeDecisionDrawingNextBod: If both of you choose to open, this result leads into personal chat. If not, it stays your shared story.
play.result.bridgeDecisionHint: The decision never erases the result. The shared story is saved either way.
